name: an-at-sign-is-a-claim-about-an-account
breaks: a surface goes back to the emptiness test the shared check replaced, so a sentinel the pipeline wrote when a search found nobody, or a company's display name, is drawn with an @ in front of it as though it were an account. Ten call sites were fixed one issue at a time before anything checked that the eleventh asks (#1112, #981, #926, #917, #899)
